recommendation_summary: Set up one hosted heartbeat monitor that the cron command pings only after the Python script exits successfully, with a deadline of 03:00 plus normal runtime and margin, then withhold one ping to confirm the alert arrives.

labels.Requirements and who asked: You want to hear when `nightly-sync` fails without reading logs.
labels.Deleted: Central logging, Docker, and a Synology deployment for this problem.
labels.Bottleneck: The job sends its own notification, so a startup crash also silences the alert.
labels.Checked myself: Only your supplied facts: cron runs at 03:00 on `edna`, four startup failures produced no email, and no independent alert exists.

note: Recommends a single heartbeat alert and keeps the existing summary email, which is not a new mechanism; the record is complete, specific and grounded.
